title: The Shadow of the Holy Sect
next_chapter_hook: A Holy Sect Elder冷笑道：“The Heavenly Fate Lock is about to mature. It is time to harvest.”

text.content: Just as Chen Ji tried to extract more information from the remnant soul, a low growl echoed from the depths of the Forbidden Grounds, awakening something that had slumbered for countless years. The sound was like an ancient giant beast rousing, shaking the entire ruins. Countless dust particles drifted down from the rocky walls. Cracks spread across the stone slabs beneath Chen Ji's feet, and an oppressive might surged forth like a tide. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul trembled violently on the first page, issuing a warning: "It comes... faster than this old man anticipated!" Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his fingertips cold. The unease in his heart grew stronger.

Chen Ji's figure flickered, darting like a specter into the shadow of a broken stone pillar. He收敛 all his presence to a state of near nothingness, slowing his breathing to almost stillness. This was the survival skill he had honed during his ten years in the Servants' Quarters—how to become invisible before the strong. Moments later, several figures emerged from the darkness of the ruins' depths, their black robes embroidered with dark purple patterns, emanating an eerie spiritual light. Chen Ji recognized that attire all too well—it was the mark of the Holy Sect. The leader was an elderly man with white hair, his features malevolent, his spiritual pressure as abyssal as the sea. He was a Void Refining realm great one!

dialogue.content: "The seal here has loosened by three parts. Speed up, everyone. The clue to the shackles lies ahead. That thing... the Sacred Lord is determined to obtain it." The white-robed elder coldly ordered, his voice hoarse like dead leaves rubbing together.

text.content: Chen Ji held his breath and focused, his gaze sharp as a hawk's. He quickly scanned the Holy Sect arrivals—six Inner Disciples, two Elders, plus the white-haired elder at the head. With his current cultivation, any one of them could crush him to dust with a single finger. But he did not retreat. Instead, he quietly activated the Tianji Record Fragment. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul warned in a low voice: "Consuming five points of Heavenly Fate will allow you to窥见 this person's movements for three hours. Are you certain?" Chen Ji did not hesitate—his life was at stake. In an instant, a profound stream of information flooded his mind, and he "saw" the white-haired elder's subsequent trajectory.

However, at that moment, whispered voices reached Chen Ji's ears. He looked over to see two Holy Sect Inner Disciples falling behind, conversing in low tones. "Did you hear? The 'Heavenly Fate Lock' has been cultivated enough. After this mission, we'll have a great achievement!" Another person lowered his voice: "Shh, be quiet. That thing is the Sacred Lord's lifeblood. I heard even the Saint Maiden envies it greatly." Chen Ji's heart contracted violently, his blood seeming to freeze in an instant. Heavenly Fate Lock... Lock... Chen Nian!

dialogue.content: The white-haired elder suddenly stopped, his turbid eyeballs rolling as he scanned his surroundings. Chen Ji's heart tightened; he hastily sealed the Tianji Record's aura completely. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul urgently said in his consciousness: "They sensed the Fragment's fluctuation! Quickly gather your mind!" The elder furrowed his brow, then shook his head, as if dismissing his own paranoia, and continued leading the group forward.

text.content: Chen Ji pressed against the cold stone wall, his back soaked with cold sweat. His fist slowly clenched within his sleeve, fingernails digging deep into his palm. The pain was far less than the fury in his heart. His sister had been missing for years, and he had been investigating in secret, never expecting the truth to be so horrifying. Holy Sect... Heavenly Fate Lock... What have they turned Chen Nian into?! A savage killing intent churned in his chest. He恨不得 now rushing out to tear those black-robed scum to shreds. But reason was like a basin of cold water, extinguishing the flames of his冲动— he could not expose himself, absolutely not.

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul seemed to sense his emotional turbulence, sighing softly: "Young friend, impulse is the devil. Your current cultivation is not even worth an ant before that Void Refining cultivator. If you wish to save your sister, you must first survive." Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly suppressing the sea of rage in his heart. His gaze regained that波澜不惊 calm. But deep within his pupils, a hatred that could burn everything burned. He记下了 this debt. One day, he would collect it with interest.

choice.prompt: The Holy Sect's forces were right before his eyes, and Chen Nian's crisis was more urgent than imagined. Chen Ji needed to make a choice—

choices.description: Suppress the fire in his heart and continue tailing the Holy Sect team to gather more intelligence. This was the prudent strategy, but the internal torment was like a dull blade cutting at his flesh.
choices.visible_cost: Endure psychological torment, temporarily unable to vent anger
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the Holy Sect's complete action plan in the ruins, possibly uncover more clues about Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: If discovered, he will fall into the Holy Sect's encirclement

text.content: Chen Ji clenched his molars, transforming the killing intent in his heart into invisible wings, silently following the Holy Sect team. The white-haired elder stopped before an altar ahead. The altar was covered in obscure runes, faintly emanating the aura of a seal. The elder冷笑一声: "As expected, it's here. Activate it, awaken the 'Lock's resonance." Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply—Lock's resonance? Could Chen Nian be nearby?

choices.description: At the edge of理智崩溃, Chen Ji decided to take a desperate risk, deliberately exposing himself to draw attention and buy time for his sister to relocate. He had already prepared to die.
choices.visible_cost: May die on the spot, leaving his sister without last hope
choices.visible_reward: If he survives to escape, he will completely expose the Holy Sect's conspiracy and trigger intervention from other forces
choices.risk_hint: A life-or-death situation, unless a miracle occurs

text.content: Just as Chen Ji prepared to step out of the shadows, Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shuddered violently, a pure stream of soul power flooding into his Mental Sea, forcibly suppressing the savage冲动. "Do not!" The remnant soul's voice was rarely tinged with urgency, "You think dying will save her? If you die, who will break this chess game of fate?" Chen Ji stiffened all over, his理智勉强 returning. He closed his eyes, locking all his anger back into the deepest recesses of his heart. Mo Xiansheng was right—he could not die, not yet.

The runes on the altar suddenly blazed, dark purple light shooting skyward, resonating with the growls from the Forbidden Grounds' depths. The white-haired elder formed seals with both hands, chanting incantations. A profound formation pattern slowly unfolded in the air. "Excellent, the resonance has been established." A sinister curve twisted at the corner of his mouth, "Inform the Sacred Lord, the 'Lock's' induction range has been confirmed. Begin preparations for the harvest." Chen Ji's heart was gripped tightly by an invisible hand—they were going to harm his sister right before his eyes!

Just then, another growl echoed from the Forbidden Grounds' depths, this time clearer. Chen Ji felt a sharp pain in his eardrums, and the scene before him began to distort. He saw a massive phantom lurking in the darkness—an ancient divine beast's remnant soul, imprisoned beneath the seal. And now, the seal was loosening. More critically, the resonance formation pattern seemed to be drawing power from the divine beast! "So that's how it is..." Chen Ji instantly understood everything, "They intend to use the divine beast's power to accelerate the 'Lock's' maturation!"

dialogue.content: The white-haired elder suddenly turned his head, his gaze like lightning, directly staring at the direction of the stone pillar where Chen Ji was hiding. 'Come out, little mouse.' His voice was unhurried, yet carried an undeniable pressure. 'Old me sensed someone lurking in the shadows long ago. A mere Foundation Building ant thinks they can play hide-and-seek with old me?' The Holy Sect disciples instantly dispersed, surrounding the stone pillar. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a sigh of despair in his consciousness: 'Discovered... This is big trouble.'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stepped out from the shadows, his face wearing an expression of mingled fear and terror, the perfect image of a disciple whose courage had been shattered. His knees trembled slightly, his voice quavering: 'E... Everyone, please spare me! I'm just a servant disciple from Tianqing Sect, I wandered here by accident, please let me go!' His acting was incredibly convincing—eyes reddened, body cowering—anyone would see only a cowardly wretch. But his eyes were rapidly calculating escape routes—thirty-six strategies, retreat is best, but surrounded now, the chance of breaking through was extremely low.

choice.prompt: Facing the scrutiny of a great master at the Soul Transformation realm, Chen Ji needed to find a life-saving excuse—

choices.description: Continue acting the role of a useless servant, claiming to know nothing, just a lost wretch trying to make them lose interest and let him go.
choices.visible_cost: Need to endure humiliation and dignity trampling from Holy Sect disciples
choices.visible_reward: If successful in escaping, will gain opportunity for in-depth investigation
choices.risk_hint: The white-haired elder is extremely scheming and may see through the disguise

dialogue.content: 'Waste?' The white-haired elder snorted coldly, a spiritual pressure like a mountain crushing over. Chen Ji groaned, dropping to one knee. A thread of blood trickled from the corner of his mouth, yet his eyes still filled with fear and pleading. 'Forget it.' The old man waved his hand. 'Just an ant, too insignificant to dirty old me's hand. Throw him out.' A Holy Sect disciple stepped forward, grabbed Chen Ji by the collar, dragging him toward the exit like a dead dog. Chen Ji sneered internally—bit the bait. Once outside the forbidden grounds, he would immediately activate the backup contact method, passing the Holy Sect's conspiracy to Ye Qing.

choices.description: Reveal knowledge of some information about the Tianji Record, attempting to exchange this for the Holy Sect's attention and cooperation, buying himself more time and leverage.
choices.visible_cost: Exposing having clues to the Tianji Record may bring fatal danger
choices.visible_reward: If the other party takes the bait, will gain opportunity to approach Holy Sect core intelligence, possibly even approach Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: If deemed a threat, will be killed on the spot

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly stopped trembling, lifted his head, a gleam of sharpness flashing in his eyes. 'Elder, please wait!' His voice no longer trembled, replaced by a composure unbecoming of a wretch. 'Although this junior's cultivation is low, this junior... knows some things about the 'Tianji Record'.' The white-haired elder's pupils contracted sharply, that disdain instantly vanished, replaced by scrutiny and greed. 'What did you say?' Chen Ji stood up, brushed the dust from his robes, a faint smile curving his lips: 'This junior wishes to use this as a token of allegiance, in exchange for an opportunity to cooperate with the elder.'

text.content: The white-haired elder looked Chen Ji up and down, a playful glint flickering in his eyes. 'Interesting.' He stepped forward, his withered fingers lifting Chen Ji's chin. 'Mere Foundation Building realm, yet dares to play tricks before old me. Are you truly not afraid of death, or do you have something to rely on?' Chen Ji stared directly into those murky yet dangerous eyes, not dodging: 'This junior fears death, but this junior fears living miserably even more. Since Holy Sect can cultivate 'Lock Keys,' surely their ambitions are grand. This junior wishes to seek a future for himself.' The old man burst into laughter, the sound echoing through the empty ruins: 'Bold! Old me admires people like you.'

'However—' The old man's tone suddenly turned cold. 'If you dare deceive old me, your ending will be worse than death.' He waved his hand. 'Take him along. When the mission is complete, bring him back to Holy Sect for interrogation.' Chen Ji's heart eased—he had won the gamble. He was escorted by two Holy Sect disciples, following the team deeper into the ruins. With each step, he silently calculated the route in his mind, while carving every piece of information into his memory. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul whispered in his consciousness: 'Act carefully, this is your chance to approach the truth, but it may also be a trap.' Chen Ji responded in his heart: I know. But for Chen Nian, it's worth it.

The team stopped before a massive underground palace. The palace gates stood ten zhang high, covered with the same talismans as the altar, now emitting an eerie purple glow. The white-haired elder stepped forward, formed seals with both hands, and the gates slowly opened. A rotten and ancient aura rushed toward them. Chen Ji felt a sharp sting in his mind, and the Tianji Record Fragment actually vibrated on its own. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul exclaimed in alarm: 'This is... an ancient sealing ground! Whatever is sealed inside is not simple!' Chen Ji endured the discomfort, his gaze piercing through the gates, looking into the depths of the palace—there, vaguely visible, a slender figure was suspended in mid-air by chains.

Although the figure was blurry, Chen Ji recognized her at a glance—it was Chen Nian! His sister! The little girl who used to tie her hair in double buns and follow him calling 'Brother.' Now with disheveled hair and ragged clothes, wrapped in countless dark purple chains. Her face was pale as paper, eyes tightly closed, surrounded by an eerie spiritual light, as if something was drawing away her life force. Chen Ji's reason collapsed in an instant, a tidal wave of fury erupting from his chest. His whole body trembled, knuckles cracking, eyes instantly bloodshot. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul urgently shouted: 'Stay calm! Charging out now is just seeking death!'

dialogue.content: The white-haired elder seemed to sense Chen Ji's abnormality and turned to glance at him. Chen Ji suddenly realized his loss of composure, quickly lowering his head to hide the killing intent in his eyes. 'What's wrong?' The old man asked with a knowing smile. Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down: 'N... Nothing, this junior was merely intimidated by the pressure here.' The old man had no suspicion, turned to look at Chen Nian bound by chains, a fanatic look appearing on his weathered face: 'Excellent, the resonance has reached critical point. In three more days, the 'Heavenly Fate Lock Key' will be completely mature. Then... Hehe, the plan for the Eye of Heavenly Dao will advance another step.'

choice.prompt: Three days... Chen Nian had only three days left. Chen Ji had to make a decision within these three days—

choices.description: Continue pretending to side with Holy Sect, gather more intelligence while looking for outside help. Three days may be short, but enough to pass news to Ye Qing or Su Qingyao.
choices.visible_cost: Must continue playing the role of traitor, may face harassment from Holy Sect disciples
choices.visible_reward: If successful, will obtain Holy Sect's core secrets and have opportunity to organize a rescue operation
choices.risk_hint: If the acting falters even slightly, it will be exposed on the spot.

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the turbulent emotions surging within his heart, lifted his head, and wore a sycophantic smile: "Senior's wisdom is truly remarkable. The junior is willing to serve the Holy Sect with utmost dedication. Does the senior have any commands?" The white-haired elder nodded with satisfaction: "A person who knows the current situation. Stay by my side. Perhaps your knowledge of the Tianji Record will prove useful later." Chen Ji sneered in his heart—useful? When you discover the truth, you'll realize who is truly using whom. Silently, he condensed a thread of divine consciousness into a fine line, and while no one was watching, quietly transmitted a signal outward. Three days. That would be enough.

choices.text: Going all in with a single desperate gamble
choices.description: Taking advantage of the Holy Sect's moment of carelessness, forcibly operating the full power of the Tianji Record, attempting to disrupt the seal's stability and create chaos to buy Chen Nian a chance to escape. The cost would be the complete exhaustion of the Heavenly Fate Value.
choices.visible_cost: When the Heavenly Fate Value reaches zero, it may lead to unpredictable consequences, even instantaneous death.
choices.visible_reward: If successful, it would shake the foundations of the seal, buying Chen Nian a slim chance of survival.
choices.risk_hint: The success rate is extremely low, unless a miracle occurs.

text.content: Just as Chen Ji prepared to risk his life, a cold current of consciousness flooded into his mind—it was Ye Qing! The reply from the Demon Path Saintess: "Received your signal. Hold on, I will bring people." Chen Ji's spirits lifted, his taut nerves slightly easing. Ye Qing arrived at the perfect moment! But he couldn't place all his hopes on others. Master Mo's remnant soul sighed: "Young friend, you've done better than most. Sometimes, waiting is also a form of courage." Chen Ji closed his eyes, silently saying in his heart: Wait for me, Nian. Big brother will definitely rescue you.

The white-haired elder suddenly turned, his burning gaze fixed intently on Chen Ji: "You claim to know about the Tianji Record? Then tell me, how does one conceal the aura of a Tianji Record Fragment?" Chen Ji's heart tightened, but his expression remained unmoved: "This... the junior has only heard about it occasionally from ancestors. It's said the Tianji Record's aura is extremely unique. To completely conceal it, one would need to borrow the resonance of a treasure of equivalent tier." The elder furrowed his brows, seemingly contemplating the authenticity of Chen Ji's words. Just then, an unsettling hum echoed from deep within the palace, and the suspended Chen Nian suddenly opened her eyes—her gaze pierced through the crowd, directly toward Chen Ji, her eyes filled with terror and disbelief.

Chen Ji's breath halted in that instant. He saw Chen Nian's lips trembling slightly, as if trying to say something. Though separated by dozens of zhang, leveraging the Tianji Record's perception, he clearly captured those few words—"Brother, run quickly..." Tears instantly blurred his vision. He desperately bit his tongue, using pain to suppress the urge to rush out. Cannot leave, must not expose himself now! He took a deep breath, turned his head, forcing himself not to look at Chen Nian. But in his heart, his voice rang like an oath: Nian, wait a little longer. Big brother will definitely rescue you. Whatever the cost.

The white-haired elder seemed unaware of Chen Ji's abnormality, his full attention fixed on the rune patterns on the altar. Purple light grew increasingly intense, the entire palace trembling. The roars of the ancient divine beast drew ever closer. "The time is nearly upon us." The elder coldly smiled, raising his hand to channel a spiritual technique: "Activate the final seal, channel all the divine beast's power into the key!" Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply, an overwhelming hatred surging in his heart. He stared fixedly at the elder's back, carving this ugly visage into his bones. Someday, he would personally tear apart this face! Master Mo's remnant soul quietly said: "Remember this anger, young friend. In the future, it will become your sharpest blade."

As the Holy Sect members busied themselves activating the seal, Chen Ji quietly slipped his hand into his sleeve, crushing the communication jade talisman Ye Qing had left him. An invisible ripple penetrated the palace's封锁, transmitting the final message outward: Heavenly Fate Key, Forbidden Grounds altar, within three days, come quickly. After completing this, Chen Ji raised his head, gazing at that slender figure bound by chains, a resolute arc curling at the corner of his lips. Sister, wait for me. Whether before me lies mountains of blades or abysses of fire, big brother will definitely come to rescue you. This time, I will not let anyone hurt you again. The shadow of the Holy Sect loomed over the entire ruins, but the fire in Chen Ji's heart burned ever more intensely.
